title: Module-Private Encapsulation using File-Scope Static
description:
In large firmware projects without object-oriented class syntax, file-scope `static` variables and functions provide information hiding and modularity.

Any file-scope symbol declared `static` has internal linkage and is completely inaccessible outside this file.

### Requirements:
1. `pwm_set_duty(duty_pct, period_ticks)`: Configures internal driver state.
2. `pwm_get_output(current_tick)`: Calculates output level based on modulo period phase.
hint: Internal linkage prevents symbol collisions between multiple driver modules across the build.
